rules.implementationNote: Requires archived fda-m1-conditional-v1 policy, exact catalog source authorization and pinned official bytes. Missing resources yield NotEvaluated. DTD prerequisites and Formal qualification remain in force.

rules.sourceSection: FDA eCTD Validation Criteria 4.7, p. 53, error 2045; official severity Medium; effective 2015-06-15
rules.title: Invalid form type for eCTD location
rules.applicableScope: US M1 DTD 3.3, bound selection date on or after 2015-06-15. M1 2.6 Table 10: forms directly under administrative submission-information allow only Form FDA 1571 and Form FDA 356h. Missing form types remain NotEvaluated; this does not claim all M1 placement or patent form rules.
rules.implementationNote: Requires archived fda-m1-conditional-v1 policy, exact catalog source authorization and pinned official bytes. Missing resources yield NotEvaluated. DTD prerequisites and Formal qualification remain in force.

rules.sourceSection: M1 2.6 Tables 2/3, PDF pages 11/12; project mapping, no FDA error-number attribution
rules.title: Supplement effective type combination
rules.applicableScope: Bound US M1 supplement/application inputs and exact archived combination policy; selection date from 2015-06-15
rules.implementationNote: Each application evaluated independently; missing/ambiguous or unauthorized mapping is NotEvaluated; old catalogs do not gain this project rule

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 24, error 1519; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Application number does not match the folder name
rules.applicableScope: Compare the single file-owning application number to an observed six-digit application directory; missing or unsupported directory naming is NotEvaluated. No prefix stripping or database identity substitution.
rules.implementationNote: Exact pinned FDA source and bound date required. Source layout is input-digest bound for new captures; legacy captures remain readable without fabricating evidence. DTD and full regional qualification remain separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 28, error 1714; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Sequence number does not match the folder name
rules.applicableScope: Compare the single file-owning XML sequence to the observed four-digit source directory; an explicitly selected root-only ZIP is not physical directory evidence.
rules.implementationNote: Exact pinned FDA source and bound date required. Source layout is input-digest bound for new captures; legacy captures remain readable without fabricating evidence. DTD and full regional qualification remain separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 49, error 2033; effective 2015-06-15
rules.title: Different sequence numbers are referenced for the same application number
rules.applicableScope: Within a grouped M1, the same primary application type and six-digit number must use the same four-digit sequence across regulatory activities; ambiguous identities are NotEvaluated.
rules.implementationNote: Exact pinned FDA source and bound date required. Source layout is input-digest bound for new captures; legacy captures remain readable without fabricating evidence. DTD and full regional qualification remain separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 11, error 1221; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: File name exceeds maximum length (64 characters) per eCTD specification
rules.applicableScope: Captured target-sequence filenames including extensions; independent of XML parsing. Historical inputs are not reclassified by this current rule. Exact archived FDA source and bound selection date required.
rules.implementationNote: Official Low severity retained as Info. Filename checks do not imply format/type validity or full regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 13, error 1298; effective 2013-04-30
rules.title: File does not contain a file extension
rules.applicableScope: Captured target-sequence filenames including extensions; independent of XML parsing. Historical inputs are not reclassified by this current rule. Exact archived FDA source and bound selection date required.
rules.implementationNote: Official Medium severity retained as Warning. Filename checks do not imply format/type validity or full regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 13, error 1276; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Leaf element title leads or ends with a space
rules.applicableScope: Original target-sequence leaf title elements; leading/trailing ASCII space and missing/nonblank title checks. Duplicate/complex title structure, incomplete parsing or exhausted finding budget remain NotEvaluated. Historical inputs retain their own rules.
rules.implementationNote: Exact archived official source and bound selection date required; no current-resource substitution or formal qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 13, error 1289; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Omitted leaf element title
rules.applicableScope: Original target-sequence leaf title elements; leading/trailing ASCII space and missing/nonblank title checks. Duplicate/complex title structure, incomplete parsing or exhausted finding budget remain NotEvaluated. Historical inputs retain their own rules.
rules.implementationNote: Exact archived official source and bound selection date required; no current-resource substitution or formal qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 6, error 1034; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Invalid leaf element operation
rules.applicableScope: Explicit operation presence in captured target ICH and US leaf elements; missing, blank or defaulted values fail. Unknown explicit values and incomplete parsing remain NotEvaluated; DTD and lifecycle validity are separate.
rules.implementationNote: Official Medium maps to Warning. Exact archived original, provenance and selection date required; no guessed new operation or full regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 11, error 1204; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: File name contains invalid characters: tilde(~), forward slash(/), backslash(\), colon(:), asterisk(*), question mark(?), single quote('), double quote(") less than(<), greater than(>), pipe(|), or space( )
rules.applicableScope: Actual captured target-sequence filenames, without URI decoding, against the explicit FDA forbidden-character set. Nonportable names refused by input capture never produce a passing FDA result; their rejection remains an input prerequisite.
rules.implementationNote: Official Low maps to Info. Explicit archived original/provenance and bound selection date required. Does not classify raw slash separators as filename characters or equate safe path capture with FDA acceptance.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 15, error 1322; effective 2013-04-30
rules.title: Folder contains no files or sub folders
rules.applicableScope: Captured target-sequence directories containing neither files nor subfolders. Parent folders with child directories are not empty. Surrounding inputs are not silently adopted; directory findings have no downloadable file address.
rules.implementationNote: Official Low maps to Info. Exact archived original/provenance and selection date required. Independent directory/ZIP capture binds the observed empty-directory inventory.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 4, error 2; effective 2017-04-02
rules.title: eCTD submission missing us-regional.xml file
rules.applicableScope: Exact target-sequence m1/us/us-regional.xml file presence. Historical, surrounding, wrong-case and wrong-path files or directories do not satisfy this check; XML content validity is assessed separately.
rules.implementationNote: Official High maps to Error. Exact archived original/provenance and explicit selection date required. Reads the reverified captured target inventory and shares the file-stage finding budget.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 7, error 1051; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Extraneous leaf element path
rules.applicableScope: Nonempty xlink:href on an explicitly delete target leaf. Only target backbones are assessed; unknown or defaulted operations and incomplete XML cannot establish a pass.
rules.implementationNote: Official Medium maps to Warning. Exact archived source and explicit selection date required. Path values remain undecoded and located in the owning backbone; known failures take precedence over incomplete coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 7, error 1068; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Extraneous modified leaf element path
rules.applicableScope: Nonempty modified-file on an explicitly new target leaf. Only target backbones are assessed; unknown or defaulted operations and incomplete XML cannot establish a pass.
rules.implementationNote: Official Medium maps to Warning. Exact archived source and explicit selection date required. Path values remain undecoded and located in the owning backbone; known failures take precedence over incomplete coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 9, error 1136; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Omitted leaf element path
rules.applicableScope: Target backbone content leaves with an explicit new, append or replace operation require a nonblank XLink href.
rules.implementationNote: Missing or blank content path only. Presence does not establish path validity, file existence or history resolution. Delete does not deliver content.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 10, error 1153, effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Missing modified file
rules.applicableScope: Supplied modified-file references on target sequence leaves, resolved against the explicitly selected application sequences.
rules.implementationNote: An absent file in a selected sequence or a missing leaf in a completely read backbone establishes failure. Missing history, unread backbones and ambiguous references remain unevaluated. Lookup is relative to captured bytes.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 11, error 1170, effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Omitted leaf element modified file path
rules.applicableScope: Target sequence leaves with an explicit replace, append or delete operation.
rules.implementationNote: The unqualified modified-file attribute must contain a nonblank path for these operations.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 12, error 1238, effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: File size exceeds maximum limit (400 MB)
rules.applicableScope: Captured files in the selected target sequence, measured in uncompressed bytes.
rules.implementationNote: The general size screen covers lengths up to 400000000 bytes and reports declared PDFs with a PDF header above 419430400 bytes. The intervening byte range and other large file types require further assessment. Dataset applicability and effective-date qualification remain open.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 12, error 1255. FDA Specifications for File Format Types Using eCTD Specifications v9.3 pp. 3-7.
rules.title: Invalid file extension
rules.applicableScope: Content leaves in the target ICH backbone and the captured files they reference in the target sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Selected module-level rows in archived FDA format revision 9.3 for M2 through M5, including SVG in M3-M5 and RMD/JSON/CAS/DAT in M5. Actual backbone module governs, not the physical folder name. Regional/subsection placement, remaining formats, permissible uses, archive-copy requirements and historical revisions remain unqualified; status remains Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 14, error 1306. ICH eCTD v3.2 Q&A 36 item 13.
rules.title: No leaf element for file
rules.applicableScope: Captured target module folders m1 through m5 excluding nested util directories.
rules.implementationNote: Resolves target ICH and regional leaf references to exact logical file paths after complete backbone capture.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 14, error 1314. ICH eCTD Q&A 51.
rules.title: Non-required file exists
rules.applicableScope: Files in the selected target sequence's util folder.
rules.implementationNote: Recognizes pinned utility paths and bytes, including other regional assets, and locates Finder metadata. Additional regional and miscellaneous file classifications require further assessment.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 8, error 1111
rules.title: More than one version of the us-regional.xml file exists
rules.applicableScope: US regional backbone files and ICH M1 regional references in the captured target sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Counts physical us-regional.xml files and regional references independently. Known duplicates are retained when the other observation is incomplete.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 9, error 1119. ICH eCTD 3.2.2 Appendix 6 p. 6-2 and Q&A 36 items 2, 6 and 8.
rules.title: Missing required file
rules.applicableScope: Required ICH backbone DTD and observed conditional STF utility references in the selected target sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Checks ICH main DTD and observed STF 2.2 DTD, declared local stylesheet, and valid-values dependency proven by the supported stylesheet and archived sources. Creation-time ICH stylesheets, historical support variants and unresolved conditional discovery remain unqualified; US M1 3.3 website support references are not universally required as local utilities.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 9, error 1130. ICH Q&A 36 items 2, 6 and 8.
rules.title: Required file checksum value in the util folder must match the expected checksum
rules.applicableScope: Delivered main ICH DTD and recognized conditional STF utilities in the target sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Compares ICH main DTD, identified STF DTD 2.2 and stylesheet 2.3 with archived published MD5 values, and recognizes exact valid-values 6.0 bytes using the explicitly versioned ICH webpage checksum. Unknown stylesheet/valid-values versions remain NotEvaluated, not corrupt current versions. Creation-time ICH stylesheets and historical/other support variants remain unqualified.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 6, error 1038
rules.title: Application form and cover letter should be New
rules.applicableScope: Application form and cover letter leaves of the target US regional backbone.
rules.implementationNote: Locates explicit non-new operations on correctly rooted target FDA form/cover-letter sections, with unique XML observations and exact rules/assets/limits binding. Missing, duplicate, cyclic or over-budget ancestry stays unknown while prior known failures are retained. Actual main-form versus attachment identity, full scope and corrective-document replacement exceptions remain unqualified.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 8, error 1102
rules.title: Leaf path contains invalid characters
rules.applicableScope: Explicit local path defects in non-delete leaves of current captured ICH and US regional backbones.
rules.implementationNote: Detects explicit unnormalized local href values containing backslash, colon within a later path segment, asterisk, less-than, greater-than, pipe or space. Requires complete rooted current XML and exact rules/assets/limits binding. Default/missing/raw-value conflicts, URI schemes, percent encoding, query/fragment syntax, delete leaves, historical sources and other XML scopes remain unqualified. No Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 15, error 1323. ICH Q&A 36 item 12.
rules.title: No file for leaf element
rules.applicableScope: Target ICH and US regional backbone leaf file references within the explicitly captured sequence set.
rules.implementationNote: Checks exact referenced file existence. Unavailable history and unresolved paths remain unevaluated; regional permission to reuse files across sequences is a separate check.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 16, error 1344
rules.title: Attribute value leads or ends with a space
rules.applicableScope: Explicit attributes in target ICH and US regional backbones and discovered STF documents, before DTD type normalization.
rules.implementationNote: Checks XML-decoded explicit values for leading or trailing U+0020 before DTD normalization in current backbones and discovered STF documents. Requires unique exact XML input/rules/assets/limits binding, current paths, unique document/element/leaf indexes and bounded work. DTD defaults remain excluded; missing raw values, incomplete discovery, unread or inconsistent evidence remain unknown while known failures survive. Other XML scopes remain unqualified.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 16, error 1357; pinned ICH DTD heading declarations; STF specification 2.6.1 pp. 5-7
rules.title: Required attribute value omitted in M2 - M5
rules.applicableScope: Target ICH M2.3.S, M3.2.S, M2.7.3 and M5.3.5 heading attributes, and STF categories bound to actual ICH section references.
rules.implementationNote: Checks required heading substance/manufacturer/indication and known STF species/route-of-admin/type-of-control categories using actual target index references and exact heading ancestry. Shared STF references union requirements. Duration applicability, regional category variants, missing placement and incomplete discovery remain unevaluated; complete STF attribute qualification remains open.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 17, error 1362; STF specification 2.6.1 pp. 5-7
rules.title: An attribute appears multiple times in the stf.xml file
rules.applicableScope: Known study-identifier category declarations within each target STF document.
rules.implementationNote: Detects repeated known study categories per current STF, with unique XML/rules/assets/limits binding, unique document/element indexes, exact locations and bounded traversal. Duplicate observation facts are not duplicate business categories; known failures survive later unknown evidence. Unknown category/realm and other business-attribute scopes remain unqualified; file-tags and properties are not study categories.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 17, error 1368; pinned ICH DTD heading, leaf and node-extension declarations; STF specification 2.6.1 pp. 5-7
rules.title: Extraneous attribute
rules.applicableScope: Explicit attributes on qualified current ICH headings, leaves and node-extensions, and known STF study categories bound to actual target section references.
rules.implementationNote: Checks ICH headings and known STF categories plus explicit leaf/node-extension attributes under qualified ICH section chains. New content scope uses exact XML/rules/assets/limits binding, unique indexes, bounded ancestry/work, namespace-aware declared attributes and shared finding capacity. Defaults are excluded and unavailable explicit evidence stays unknown. Regional, other content/STF scopes, unknown realms and duration outside qualified examples remain unqualified; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 18, error 1374; ICH specification 3.2.2 sections 2-2 and 6-2
rules.title: Checksum value must match the actual checksum
rules.applicableScope: Valid MD5 declarations on target ICH/US backbone leaves and in target index-md5.txt.
rules.implementationNote: Compares valid MD5 values with captured bytes, including referenced STF files and explicitly supplied history. MD5 algorithm names are case-insensitive without trimming. Fixed ICH/US DTDs declare checksums on leaves; STF has no internal checksum attribute. Unavailable files and invalid comparison evidence remain unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 18, error 1391
rules.title: Invalid checksum formatting in index-md5.txt
rules.applicableScope: Target sequence index-md5.txt byte format.
rules.implementationNote: Requires exactly 32 ASCII hexadecimal bytes, with no whitespace or encoding marker. Missing or unreadable target files remain unevaluated; checksum matching is separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 19, error 1408; ICH specification 3.2.2 section 6-10
rules.title: Invalid checksum type
rules.applicableScope: Explicit checksum-type attributes of target ICH and US regional backbone leaves.
rules.implementationNote: Accepts MD5 algorithm names case-insensitively without trimming on target ICH/US leaves, including leaves referencing STF files. Fixed STF DTD has no internal checksum-type attribute. Missing declarations and unread backbones remain unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 19, error 1425; ICH specification 3.2.2 sections 6-4 and 6-10
rules.title: Omitted checksum value
rules.applicableScope: Target ICH/US backbone leaves explicitly using new, append or replace.
rules.implementationNote: Requires nonblank unqualified checksum values on content operations; delete is excluded. Unknown/default operations and unsupported XML scopes remain unevaluated; checksum format and matching are separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 19, error 1426; ICH specification 3.2.2 section 6-4
rules.title: Unexpected checksum value
rules.applicableScope: Target ICH/US backbone leaves explicitly using delete.
rules.implementationNote: Rejects any nonempty unqualified checksum on target ICH/US explicit delete leaves, including whitespace. Missing/empty values do not trigger this rule; DTD completeness remains separate. Fixed STF DTD has no internal checksum or operation attribute; STF lifecycle declarations are on backbone leaves. Unknown operations and unread backbones remain unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 4, error 3
rules.title: Single file submission
rules.applicableScope: Explicit submission input role, including preflight inputs without a sequence backbone.
rules.implementationNote: Distinguishes a directly supplied file from a directory or valid ZIP container; one member in a container is not a single-file submission. Preflight freezes role and complete stable input inventory.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 20, error 1442; fixed ICH DTD root dtd-version declaration
rules.title: Omitted DTD version in index.xml
rules.applicableScope: Explicit dtd-version declaration on the target index.xml root.
rules.implementationNote: Distinguishes explicit root attributes from DTD defaults. A retained complete root attribute set supports presence or omission even if later XML content fails. Missing or ambiguous root facts and unsupported explicit versions remain unevaluated; historical roots are excluded.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 20, error 1445; fixed US M1 3.3 DTD root declaration
rules.title: Omitted DTD version in US regional XML
rules.applicableScope: Explicit dtd-version declarations on all target selected US regional roots.
rules.implementationNote: Checks every selected regional root, including delivered default and referenced custom files. DTD defaults do not supply explicit versions. Known omissions survive other unread evidence; incomplete selection or unavailable roots cannot pass. Historical and unselected files are excluded.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 21, error 1476; fixed ICH/US node-extension declarations
rules.title: Node-extension exists
rules.applicableScope: Unqualified node-extension elements in target ICH and selected US regional backbones.
rules.implementationNote: Reports every retained target extension element, including nested and optional-ID extensions, independently of lifecycle identity. Known elements survive later read failures; incomplete XML selection cannot prove absence. Foreign namespaces and historical documents are excluded; fixed STF DTD has no node-extension element.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 22, error 1478; ICH/US node-extension content declarations
rules.title: Node-extension does not have a title
rules.applicableScope: Direct title-element presence on target ICH/US node-extension elements.
rules.implementationNote: Checks exact unqualified direct title elements, not descendant leaf/nested titles. Empty or whitespace titles still exist; duplicate/order validity remains separate. Incomplete documents cannot prove title absence; known failures from complete documents survive other unread scope.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 22, error 1482
rules.title: Node-extension title leads or ends with a space
rules.applicableScope: Boundary U+0020 characters on direct target ICH/US node-extension titles.
rules.implementationNote: Uses exact XML-decoded text without trimming or repeated decoding. Only direct unqualified titles without element children supply text. Incomplete documents preserve a known leading space but cannot establish the final trailing character; foreign namespaces and history are excluded.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 25, error 1545; US M1 specification pp. 6 and 45; captured submission/contact dictionaries
rules.title: Promotional labeling and advertising regulatory contact is missing
rules.applicableScope: Contact names in each target US regional admin with a confirmed fdast8 submission.
rules.implementationNote: Uses the captured M1 policy and active codes fdast8/fdaact4. Any structurally unambiguous promotional application triggers a nonblank contact-name requirement in the same admin. Known triggers/matches survive unknown siblings; unknown codes, ambiguous or unread structures remain unevaluated. Phone/email completeness is separate; other regional/history contacts cannot satisfy the target.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 25, error 1550; M1 specification 2.6 pp. 21-22
rules.title: Material-id exceeds 30 characters
rules.applicableScope: Explicit material-id attributes on the exact target US M1 promotional material heading chain.
rules.implementationNote: Counts XML-decoded CDATA values using the established project Unicode scalar convention, without trimming or normalization. Missing/empty attributes are not overlong; defaults are not supplied evidence. Exact ancestry, namespace and target scope are enforced; known overlength survives later XML failure.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 27, error 1554; M1 specification 2.6 pp. 21-22
rules.title: Promotional Material Issue Date Format is incorrect
rules.applicableScope: Explicit issue-date attributes on the exact target US M1 promotional material heading chain.
rules.implementationNote: Requires 8 ASCII digits and a valid Gregorian YYYYMMDD date using invariant exact parsing. XML-decoded CDATA values are not trimmed or decoded again. Missing attributes are not format failures; future dates and non-2253 delivery policy remain separate. Defaults and unavailable facts remain unevaluated; known failures survive later XML damage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 28, error 1681; M1 specification 2.6 pp. 21-22; captured promotional document types
rules.title: Issue-date attribute value is missing
rules.applicableScope: Each target US promotional material whose own parent group explicitly declares active fdapmdt1.
rules.implementationNote: Requires nonblank explicit issue-date per Promotional 2253 material. Exact parent type and captured dictionary determine applicability; other active types and complete empty groups create no obligation. Date format is separate. Defaults, unknown types and incomplete selection remain unevaluated; known omissions survive later XML failure.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 29, error 1731; STF specification 2.6.1 pp. 4, 10, 12-16, 19-22
rules.title: Cumulative STF files are not allowed
rules.applicableScope: Target STF documents bound to actual ICH owner leaves and their explicitly selected predecessor chains.
rules.implementationNote: Uses qualified target owners and their selected STF predecessor chains, exact leaf addresses and nearest-reference metadata. Current new/append/replace leaves remain incremental even when reusing old files; identifier-only updates are allowed. Conflicting owners, actual changes, unavailable history, ambiguous metadata and budget truncation remain unevaluated. Independent known failures survive unrelated missing references. Target owner coverage includes historical STF captures and rejected bindings.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 29; Study Data Technical Conformance Guide October 2026 pp. 64-68, 87-88
rules.title: A trial summary dataset with study start date information is required
rules.applicableScope: Actual STF studies in the listed M4/M5 sections and their captured content, with explicit primary application type and selection date.
rules.implementationNote: Checks known NDA/ANDA/BLA and common center-date branches using actual report or XPT triggers and associated TS parameter facts. Missing TS or absent start-date information can fail; unreadable/ambiguous facts do not. Center-specific transition branches, commercial IND status, NA applicability and historical TS supply remain unqualified. Partial pass is not readiness evidence.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 32; Study Data Technical Conformance Guide October 2026 pp. 51-52
rules.title: Duplicate new datasets for a study
rules.applicableScope: Datasets referenced by actual study tagging files in Module 4 or 5, including optional STF sections.
rules.implementationNote: Detects distinct current new XPT dataset leaves within a qualified STF using exact decoded basename and original direct leaf title; repeated references are deduplicated by LeafAddress, not content path. Known duplicate failures survive unrelated unknown references. Cross-STF study identity, historical lifecycle counting and other dataset formats remain unqualified; local passes do not establish readiness.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 32; Study Data Technical Conformance Guide October 2026 p. 51
rules.title: STF study identity must match the referenced trial summary
rules.applicableScope: Each actual target-owned Module 4/5 STF and its referenced ts.xpt, including qualified selected historical content and optional STF sections.
rules.implementationNote: Compares each qualified target-owned STF study-id with each associated TS using exact STUDYID or SPREFID parameter values from definite rows. Field-level unknowns and possible rows block a mismatch only when they could supply a match. Multiple TS files and studies are assessed independently; qualified selected historical content is supported. Missing or unreadable evidence remains unevaluated, and missing TS obligations belong to separate rules.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 33; STF specification v2.6.1 pp. 12, 15
rules.title: STF owner leaf must specify the DTD version
rules.applicableScope: Each actual target STF owner leaf, including owners referencing selected historical STF content.
rules.implementationNote: Checks explicit nonblank no-namespace version on each actual target STF owner leaf. Retained local omissions survive later index or STF body failures; incomplete owner discovery cannot pass. Root dtd-version and content-leaf attributes do not substitute for the owner attribute. Exact version agreement is a separate rule.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 33; STF specification v2.6.1 pp. 12, 15
rules.title: STF XML root must explicitly declare its DTD version
rules.applicableScope: Actual target STF XML files, including unreferenced files, and selected historical STF content referenced by qualified current owners.
rules.implementationNote: Checks the explicit no-namespace dtd-version on each frozen STF root. The pinned DTD default does not substitute for an explicit declaration. Retained root omissions survive later body/index damage, while incomplete discovery cannot pass; historical-only documents are not target findings. Unsupported or unreadable roots remain unevaluated, not inferred omissions. Owner attributes and version agreement are separate rules.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 34; STF specification v2.6.1 pp. 4-5, 12, 15
rules.title: STF owner and XML DTD versions must agree
rules.applicableScope: Each actual target STF owner paired with its precisely referenced frozen STF root, including selected historical content.
rules.implementationNote: Compares interpreted owner version tokens with the observed effective STF DTD version. The three archived declaration spellings are recognized for comparison, without approving their format under 1782. Actual pinned DTD defaults may be compared while 1752 still reports omitted explicit declarations. Unknown syntax/profile facts, missing roots and ambiguous observations remain unevaluated; known local mismatches survive later parse failures.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 34, error 1782 corrective action; STF specification v2.6.1
rules.title: Supported STF version declaration in owner leaf
rules.applicableScope: Actual target owners referencing established STF 2.2 content, including selected historical files; other version support branches remain unqualified.
rules.implementationNote: Enforces the exact decoded marker STF Version 2.2 for references to actual, pinned STF 2.2 files. Other nonblank values fail this known branch; missing declarations belong to 1748. Default root versions remain usable evidence without closing 1752. Other actual STF versions and date-specific support or retirement policy lack a complete archived official support list, so local passes do not establish full coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 35; STF specification v2.6.1 p. 4; pinned ICH section mapping
rules.title: Submitted study content must be referenced by an STF
rules.applicableScope: Current non-delete content leaves under m4.2 or m5.3, excluding m5.3.6, checked by exact LeafAddress and actual standard heading instance.
rules.implementationNote: Requires exact per-leaf STF references from an actual current owner in the same qualified heading/extension instance. Multiple STFs contribute a reference union; same-path leaves remain separate. Orphan STFs and historical references do not retarget current leaf events. Unrelated historical STF observations and complete invalid/other-address references do not hide proven uncovered leaves. Cross-instance or ambiguous study associations remain unqualified; local passes do not establish full coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 36, error 1799
rules.title: STF must not reference another STF
rules.applicableScope: Actual target STF files including orphan sources, and qualified current-owner selected historical STF sources.
rules.implementationNote: Resolves each STF doc-content through its exact backbone leaf to the leaf's actual content capture and verifies another STF by unique frozen root identity. Known violations survive source/target tail damage and unrelated unknown references. Complete in-scope XML discovery can establish non-STF content; extensions alone cannot. Self-reference interpretation and content identity outside completed discovery remain unqualified, so local passes do not establish full coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 36; STF specification v2.6.1 pp. 12-13
rules.title: STF must relate to leaf elements
rules.applicableScope: Actual target STF files and qualified current-owner historical sources, evaluated individually for at least one leaf association.
rules.implementationNote: One resolved leaf establishes per-STF association even when other references are unknown or invalid. Complete definite-negative references can fail; empty STFs fail only with qualified all-new current owners and no modified-file evidence. Empty identifier-only revisions, mixed or unavailable revision context remain unqualified rather than falsely rejected. Local passes do not establish full coverage of the revision inheritance exception.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 37, error 1833
rules.title: STF references must identify existing leaf elements
rules.applicableScope: Each retained doc-content reference in actual target STF files and qualified current-owner historical STF sources.
rules.implementationNote: Checks target leaf existence using complete context-bound backbone original elements, ID index and derived leaf facts. Consistent missing IDs and non-leaf targets fail; unavailable history, incomplete or contradictory facts remain unevaluated. Existing delete or subsequently inactive leaves and missing physical content do not become nonexistent leaf findings. Known local failures survive source tail damage and other unknown references.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 37, error 1850; STF specification v2.6.1 pp. 12-13
rules.title: Appended STF study identity must remain constant
rules.applicableScope: Each actual current STF append owner and its precise direct modified-file predecessor, including selected historical STF content.
rules.implementationNote: Compares unique complete decoded study-id texts using Ordinal equality on each explicit current append edge. Direct predecessors may themselves be append or replace; unavailable earlier ancestors do not redefine the pair. Historical content and multiple owner edges remain distinct. Missing, ambiguous, truncated or contradictory evidence remains unevaluated; identifier-only empty bodies do not exempt changed IDs.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 38, error 1867; STF specification v2.6.1 p. 4
rules.title: STF files must use the .xml extension
rules.applicableScope: Identified target STF content, including unreferenced files and wrong extensions, plus qualified current-owner references to selected historical STF content.
rules.implementationNote: Uses exact .xml suffix matching only after captured root identity is established. Bounded byte discovery separates ordinary content from XML-like and unresolved prefixes independently of extension. Missing content, unavailable history and contradictory identity remain unevaluated; known violations survive incomplete tails. Filename prefixes are a separate rule.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 38, error 1884; STF specification v2.6.1 pp. 4-5
rules.title: STF filenames must follow their study identity
rules.applicableScope: Identified target STFs, including unreferenced files, and qualified current-owner references to historical STF content.
rules.implementationNote: Detects incorrect stf- prefixes and compares the complete filename with stf- plus a unique complete decoded study-id plus .xml using Ordinal equality. No trimming, case folding or character replacement. Study-id alphanumeric character admissibility remains unqualified; component matches do not establish complete coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 39, error 1901; STF specification v2.6.1 p. 4
rules.title: STF leaves must use a permitted TOC location
rules.applicableScope: Current explicit non-delete ICH leaves referencing identified target or selected historical STF content.
rules.implementationNote: Detects confirmed current STF owners outside modules 4/5 using original leaf facts and exact schema-bound ancestry. Physical folders and old historical owners do not establish placement. Missing content/history, contradictory identities and regional discovery gaps remain unevaluated. Specific permitted headings within modules 4/5 and regional STF identification remain unqualified; module membership alone never passes the rule.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 39, error 1918; STF specification v2.6.1 p. 7
rules.title: STF doc-content must include a file-tag
rules.applicableScope: Complete identified target STFs and qualified current-owner references to historical STF content, checked per doc-content occurrence.
rules.implementationNote: Detects absent direct file-tag elements when complete, bidirectionally consistent doc-content structure has no ancestor block tag. Ancestor content-block tag inheritance remains unqualified and does not pass or create a speculative omission. Sibling tags never satisfy another document; invalid/truncated evidence remains unevaluated. Tag values and multiple-tag restrictions are separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 40, error 1935; pinned STF DTD doc-content declaration
rules.title: STF doc-content must not contain multiple file-tags
rules.applicableScope: Complete identified target STFs and qualified current-owner references to historical STF content, checked per doc-content occurrence.
rules.implementationNote: Counts direct file-tag elements per complete, bidirectionally consistent doc-content. Two or more produce one located failure even when attributes are identical; ancestor tags, siblings and shared hrefs are not combined. Missing tags and value validity are separate rules. Incomplete or contradictory captured identity/structure remains unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 40, error 1953; STF study-identifier title definition
rules.title: STF study title must match its referencing leaf title
rules.applicableScope: Each exact current non-delete ICH leaf referencing identified target or selected historical STF content.
rules.implementationNote: Compares complete unique decoded study-identifier/title with the original current owner title, requiring raw/derived agreement and exact address/profile/content binding. Uses Ordinal equality without trimming or case folding as an explicit implementation policy. Matching empty text establishes no mismatch, not title completeness. Document titles and historical owners are not substituted; unavailable or contradictory evidence remains unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 41, error 1969; pinned STF DTD required structure
rules.title: STF XML must have valid required structure
rules.applicableScope: Uniquely identified target STF roots and qualified current-owner historical STF roots with exact captured diagnostics or complete structural evidence.
rules.implementationNote: Consumes exact-file definite XML/DTD failure categories or complete missing Study ID/root-child structure only after captured identity and bidirectional tree checks. Limits, offline, I/O and unknown identities do not automatically become invalid XML. Declaration-only identity, discovery failure classification, empty-ID semantics and interrupted observation retention remain unqualified.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 42, error 1985; STF specification v2.6.1 study-identifier title
rules.title: STF study title must be present
rules.applicableScope: Complete identified target STF files and qualified current-owner references to historical STF content.
rules.implementationNote: Detects absent research title elements from complete unique, bidirectionally consistent and root-connected structure, without borrowing doc-content titles. A missing required element can be established despite the resulting DTD error; generic DTD failure alone is not evidence of omission. Empty/whitespace title content and ambiguous duplicate identities remain unqualified; partial reads or conflicting identities remain unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 42, error 1990; ICH Q&A60 referenced but not independently qualified
rules.title: One STF file must not be referenced across multiple sections
rules.applicableScope: Exact captured STF identities referenced by qualified current non-delete ICH owners in schema-bound standard sections.
rules.implementationNote: Detects a single resolved STF path and capture identity referenced in different standard SectionPaths. Equivalent hrefs converge, but equal hashes or Study IDs at different paths do not merge files. Same-section different heading/extension instances and full Q&A60 section semantics remain unqualified. Unknown references do not erase established cross-section failures.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 43, error 2002
rules.title: XML must conform to applicable DTD and attribute files
rules.applicableScope: Precisely bound current index, US regional and identified STF XML diagnostic observations.
rules.implementationNote: Maps exact-file Fail DTD_VALIDATION_ERROR and XML_NOT_WELL_FORMED diagnostics only after capture/profile/asset/limit and actual root identity checks. Quota, offline, I/O and profile selection failures are not schema violations. Attribute-file semantics, historical references, declaration-only identity, discovery classification and interrupted STF observation retention remain unqualified; component Pass does not establish complete FDA2002 conformance.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 44 error 2003; captured M1 specification v2.6 pp. 2 and 45
rules.title: Regional DTD and stylesheet must use approved resource locations
rules.applicableScope: Bound current US regional declarations and retained stylesheet instructions under captured M1 v2.6 from 2025-03-31.
rules.implementationNote: Detects source-prohibited local relative DTD/stylesheet locations and well-formed explicit file:/// URIs with empty host and no query/fragment. Does not open URI resources or use resolver rejection as regulatory evidence. Malformed escapes, network hosts and other URI forms remain unqualified. Current v2.6 interpretation is not backdated; historical applicability, unavailable declarations/PI, approved-URL parsing and stylesheet version identity remain incomplete. No whole-rule Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 47 error 2024; captured M1 specification v2.6 pp. 12-13 and physical pp. 7, 16-18 grouped primary application semantics
rules.title: Submission type must match the parent regulatory activity
rules.applicableScope: Unique file-owning primary XML application, including grouped submissions, compared with its explicitly selected self-identifying parent sequence for the same application.
rules.implementationNote: Compares qualified primary-application submission types after exact capture/context/tree and declared-parent binding. Grouped input requires one explicit file owner and unique type/number member identities; secondary sequence numbers and types never supply primary facts. A primary mismatch can fail; grouped primary matches remain unevaluated because secondary members are not compared. Type is not part of the parent match key. Secondary members, self-start scope, full activity history and regulatory-received parent version remain unqualified. Not applicable before 2027-01-16.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 47 error 2025; captured M1 v2.6 Tables 2/4 and III.B.3 start classification, IV and Tables 8/9 per-application grouped sequences
rules.title: A new regulatory activity must use its sequence number as submission-id
rules.applicableScope: Each uniquely identified current XML application with a captured-policy-qualified start combination, including grouped members using their own sequence numbers.
rules.implementationNote: Compares exact per-member four-digit sequence/submission-id for the seven existing source-derived start combinations. First qualifies unique type/number identities, one explicit file owner and its captured sequence; secondary members use their own XML sequence, never the directory sequence. Follow-ups are outside scope; unknown combinations stay unknown and known mismatches survive other member unknowns or work exhaustion. Grouped submission eligibility and presubmission-capable starts remain separate qualifications. No history is required, equality alone does not prove a start, and Partial component passes do not establish full coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 47 error 2026; captured M1 v2.6 Table 4 and III.B.3 follow-ups, IV and Tables 8/9 per-application grouped sequences
rules.title: A regulatory follow-up must not refer to itself as the parent activity
rules.applicableScope: Each uniquely identified current XML application with a qualified amendment/resubmission combination, including grouped members using their own sequence numbers.
rules.implementationNote: Detects exact per-member four-digit self-reference for positively qualified amendment/resubmission combinations, including grouped submissions. First qualifies unique member type/number identities, one explicit file owner and its captured sequence. Secondary members use their own XML sequences; known self-references survive later unknown members or work exhaustion. Earlier identifiers establish only absence of self-reference, not parent existence/identity/version. Future identifiers, other starts and grouped eligibility remain unqualified. No history is required; unknown starts are not inferred to be follow-ups and coverage remains Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 53 error 3001; STF v2.6.1 research/document distinction and fixed STF DTD
rules.title: STF doc-content must not include a title element
rules.applicableScope: Actual current STF files and exact historical STF files referenced by qualified current non-delete ICH owners.
rules.implementationNote: Checks direct no-namespace title element presence per complete, identity-bound, root-connected doc-content, including empty/whitespace titles. Study titles, leaf titles and block-title are not included. Current unreferenced STF files are inspected independently; history is selected by exact qualified current owners without extension filtering. Missing/ambiguous discovery or owner facts remain unevaluated and do not erase independently established failures.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 54 error 3015; fixed STF DTD doc-content/content-block content models
rules.title: STF property elements must precede sibling file-tag elements
rules.applicableScope: Complete identified current STF files and exact historical STF files referenced by qualified current non-delete ICH owners.
rules.implementationNote: Checks frozen direct sibling order independently per doc-content/content-block, requiring identity-bound complete rooted structure and agreement between Children and Elements order. Actual reverse order supports a finding despite DTD failure; generic DTD failure alone does not. Contradictory DTD Pass, partial reads and conflicting facts remain unknown. Nested file-tag/property and separate containers are not combined; missing input does not erase independent known failures.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 54 error 3029; fixed STF DTD content-block structure
rules.title: Use of STF content-block is not recommended
rules.applicableScope: Complete identified current STF files and exact historical STF files referenced by qualified current non-delete ICH owners.
rules.implementationNote: Locates every actual content-block in a complete identity-bound connected STF tree, including nested and empty blocks. DTD allowance does not exempt use, and a missing block-title does not hide a known block. Absence requires complete qualified evidence; generic DTD errors or conflicting identities remain unknown. Findings preserve FDA Medium severity and the next-planned-submission recommendation, not an immediate-resubmission requirement.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 56 error 3078; fixed ICH 3.2.2 heading structure
rules.title: Lowest-level eCTD headings should contain leaf elements
rules.applicableScope: Complete current ICH modules 2-5 standard headings with no lower standard definitions or actual extension children.
rules.implementationNote: Detects leaf absence in exact schema-bound lowest standard ICH headings after complete qualified XML and connected structure checks. A delete leaf is still a leaf element. Regional headings, extension instances and parent headings with no lower instances remain unqualified. Findings preserve Low severity and the source's no-corrective-action language; component Pass does not establish full rule coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 56 error 3102; typed strict PdfPig 0.1.15 content-processing observations
rules.title: PDF contents must be processable
rules.applicableScope: Current captured PDF-named files and exact current leaf references to selected historical PDF-named files, with manifest binding and typed processing evidence.
rules.implementationNote: Maps typed definite content failures with exact captured hashes, preserving encryption, resource-limit, I/O and unknown categories. Includes selected historical PDFs only through current leaf references whose original href resolves consistently and whose source/location and target capture are bound; findings retain current owner and actual historical source. Same historical file is inspected once; unreferenced history is excluded. No new content reads are introduced. Other reference scopes, non-PDF-named content discovery, full parser qualification and isolation remain unqualified; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 57 error 5005; FDA PDF specification 4.1 printed pp. 2-3 and Table 1; PDF Reference 1.7 Table 3.27 and pp. 149/153 for page resource inheritance
rules.title: Non-standard PDF fonts must be fully embedded
rules.applicableScope: Current captured PDF files with definite used simple-font observations under archived PDF specification 4.1 from 2016-09-21.
rules.implementationNote: Reports definite missing embedding only for actually used Type1 Helvetica, Times and Courier built-in families, distinct from FDA Table 1. Absent page Resources may use the nearest ancestor only after complete page-tree qualification; explicit dictionaries replace rather than merge, and empty/unresolved entries do not fall back. Resource aliases, descriptor conflicts and font-stream key presence cannot prove a violation or full embedding. Requires typed processing, capture binding and both archived sources. Arbitrary font identity, full/subset programs, nested/implicit resources, history, non-PDF-named contents and pre-4.1 policy remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 59 error 5032; corrective instruction about multiple filenames containing the same form number
rules.title: Avoid multiple application-form filenames for the same application
rules.applicableScope: Current captured PDF-named files in qualified regional form groups with one exact application association; filename-marker component only.
rules.implementationNote: Groups distinct current referenced files by exact application type, six-digit number and filename marker 1571 or 356h. Repeated references to one file, including URI-encoded or fragment aliases, do not count twice. Different applications or types do not mix. Complete fixed-DTD regional facts, connected structure and raw leaf agreement are required. Actual form content identity, other numbers/locations, unreferenced files, historical lifecycle and shared multi-application groups remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 60 error 5035; FDA PDF specification 4.1 printed p. 2 VERSION; PDF Reference 1.7 Table 3.25 p. 139 for Catalog Version semantics
rules.title: PDF version must conform to the applicable guidance
rules.applicableScope: Current captured ordinary-PDF files with exact headers and optional qualified direct Catalog Version names, successful processing and no extensions or metadata under archived PDF specification 4.1 from 2016-09-21.
rules.implementationNote: Compares original headers 1.0-1.7 with qualified direct Catalog Version names 1.4-1.7 using the later declaration. Key presence is separate from raw name; null, strings, numbers, indirect or unknown values remain unknown. Parsed version must agree with the original header or effective declaration. Extensions/Metadata remain unqualified. Effective versions 1.0-1.3 fail; 1.4-1.7 satisfy only this component. Both archived sources, date, processing and capture hash must bind; legacy strings are insufficient. Other catalog forms, extension/PDF-A semantics, actual feature conformance, history, non-PDF-named contents and earlier policy remain incomplete. Low severity and no corrective action for the current submission are retained; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 60 error 5038; qualified nonannual starts from captured M1 2.6 Tables 2/4 and III.B.3
rules.title: Application form must match the application and submission type
rules.applicableScope: Current exact-named files in qualified regional form groups with a unique application association.
rules.implementationNote: Reports exact 1571.pdf for NDA/ANDA/BLA, 356h.pdf for IND, and 2252.pdf for an explicitly qualified nonannual start. Preserves the original-application case and adds six explicit starting combinations from captured M1 2.6 from 2025-03-31, requiring allowed application/type/subtype and matching current submission-id/sequence. Annual reports, follow-ups, unknown/invalid combinations and unavailable source remain unknown, not negated. Binds fixed regional XML, raw leaf facts, captured filenames and unique application association. URI aliases are deduplicated per application/file. Other nonannual scopes, actual form identity, other names/locations, history and shared multi-application groups remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 61 error 5040; necessary first-object condition from Adobe PDF Reference 1.7 F.2.2 pp. 1028-1029 (https://opensource.adobe.com/dc-acrobat-sdk-docs/pdfstandards/pdfreference1.7old.pdf)
rules.title: PDF Fast Web Access must be enabled
rules.applicableScope: Current captured PDF files with a completely tokenized physical first indirect dictionary or qualified non-dictionary value within the first 1024 bytes and successful PDF processing.
rules.implementationNote: Reports a missing Linearized dictionary key or a complete first object of a qualified non-dictionary type (number, string, hex string, array, Boolean, name, null). Both require endobj and its real delimiter within the bounded 1024-byte prefix; unsupported operators, streams, references and incomplete values remain unknown. Comments, nested keys and later objects cannot supply the first declaration. A present declaration remains unverified, never Pass. Captured hashes and typed successful parsing must bind. Hint streams, offsets, incremental-update validity, historical references and non-PDF-named contents remain unqualified. Future-submission corrective wording is retained; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 61 error 5045; FDA PDF specification 4.1 printed p. 6 INITIAL VIEW SETTINGS; PDF Reference 1.7 Tables 3.25/8.2 for PageMode and explicit opening magnification
rules.title: PDF opening view must use the appropriate panel and default magnification
rules.applicableScope: Current captured PDF opening-panel settings and isolated qualified direct OpenAction Fit/positive XYZ magnification under archived PDF specification 4.1 from 2016-09-21.
rules.implementationNote: Preserves qualified panel checks with independent bookmark presence. Adds direct OpenAction array Fit or positive finite XYZ zoom after complete page-tree and target-page qualification, excluding catalog AA/Names/AcroForm and page AA. XYZ zero/null does not prove fixed zoom; malformed parameters, named/action destinations and unknown targets remain unknown. Exact capture, typed successful parsing, both archived sources and date remain required. Layout, other opening actions/destinations, inherited link/bookmark zoom, uncertain outlines, history, non-PDF-named contents and earlier policy remain unqualified; no Pass. Legacy three-field view facts cannot authorize new zoom findings; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 62 error 5055; current regional M1 and fixed-DTD ICH module 2-5 ancestry with identified PDF markup annotations
rules.title: PDF markup annotations are limited to Module 1 section 1.15
rules.applicableScope: Current captured PDFs with identified markup and qualified actual regional M1 references outside section 1.15 or ICH module 2-5 leaf references.
rules.implementationNote: Requires exact capture, successful PDF processing and complete fixed-DTD regional or ICH XML with unique connected elements/leaves and consistent locations/href. Adds actual ICH module 2-5 references, including qualified node extensions. One outside reference prevents whole-file exemption even if another reference is under regional 1.15; physical folders and titles are not ancestry. Identifies selected markup subtypes with valid rectangles and consistent optional page owners. Links/widgets and unknown subtypes are not proven markup. Missing, historical, queried or inconsistent references and legacy calls without lifecycle remain unknown. Other annotation semantics, historical/unreferenced contents and unresolved ownership remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 63 error 5057; FDA PDF specification 4.1 printed p. 4 SOURCE OF ELECTRONIC DOCUMENTS; PDF Reference 1.7 Table 3.27 p. 146 for Contents arrays
rules.title: Image-only documents should be text searchable whenever possible
rules.applicableScope: Current captured PDFs with complete bounded unfiltered page streams containing only qualified raster drawing operations under archived PDF specification 4.1 from 2016-09-21.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent image-only evidence, exact capture, successful processing, both archived sources and no extracted text. Every page must have complete q/Q/cm/Do grammar, balanced state, nonsingular transforms and valid unfiltered 8-bit Gray/RGB image XObjects. Complete Contents arrays are checked member by member and concatenated in order, preserving graphics state/operands; only explicit line boundaries between nonempty streams qualify. All members and bytes share configured work/depth and one MiB aggregate page-stream limits before allocation. Unknown/non-stream/filtered members, text in any member and ambiguous boundaries remain unknown. Empty/vector/OCR/nested/filtered content is not inferred from HasSearchableText=false. Other image encodings, OCR quality, forms/annotations/structure, history, non-PDF-named contents and earlier policy remain unqualified; no Pass; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 63 error 5100
rules.title: Broken bookmark pointing to a missing file
rules.applicableScope: Qualified GoToR bookmarks in current captured PDFs targeting an absent file in an explicitly selected current or historical sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent bounded outline-tree identity, unambiguous simple file specification, exact source capture and complete selected target inventory. Includes qualified GoToR XYZ file targets with nonnegative integer page, finite numeric/null coordinates and null/nonnegative finite zoom. File existence is separate from the target page-tree comparison in FDA5102. File specifications remain literal, not URI-decoded. Unselected history, malformed destinations, unsupported actions/specifications and existing unreadable files cannot prove absence. Historical source PDFs, other encodings and non-PDF-named contents remain unqualified; no Pass; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 63 error 5101
rules.title: Corrupt bookmark pointing to an unopenable file
rules.applicableScope: Qualified GoToR bookmarks in current captured PDFs targeting an existing explicitly selected PDF with a definite content-format opening failure.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent bookmark file identity, literal path resolution and exact source/target capture binding. Incremental association supports either observation order and retains known failure under later limits. Missing files, unselected history, generic parse messages, encryption, unsupported content, I/O and limits do not prove corrupt targets. Other actions/formats, historical source PDFs and complete parser qualification remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 64 error 5102
rules.title: Bookmark points to a non-existent page or named destination
rules.applicableScope: Qualified GoToR Fit or XYZ bookmarks in current PDFs with a zero-based page index outside an explicitly selected target PDF's complete qualified page tree.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent bookmark identity, qualified Fit/XYZ syntax, raw nonnegative zero-based index and source/target capture binding. XYZ coordinates must be finite numbers/null and zoom null/nonnegative finite; zoom selection does not alter page indexing. Target page tree must have unique indirect identities, consistent parents and subtree Counts, complete bounded traversal and parsed-page agreement. Both observation orders and shared budgets retain known failure. Missing/unreadable targets, unselected history, legacy or conflicting page counts cannot prove absent pages. Named destinations, internal bookmarks, other modes and historical source PDFs remain unqualified; no Pass; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 64 error 5103
rules.title: Bookmark triggers multiple actions
rules.applicableScope: Independently qualified current-PDF bookmarks with complete supported GoToR action chains triggering more than one action.
rules.implementationNote: Requires complete bounded outline identity, exact capture, consistent successful parsing and an independently counted complete action chain. Adds qualified GoToR XYZ destinations throughout bookmark chains, with nonnegative integer page, finite numeric/null coordinates and null/nonnegative finite zoom. Explicit enablement is limited to the bookmark caller; hyperlink action-chain qualification is unchanged. Action Next dictionary/array traversal is distinct from outline sibling Next. Unknown or malformed tails, cycles, conflicts, unsupported actions/filespecs and exhausted work/depth/link budgets cannot publish partial counts. Other action types and historical source PDFs remain unqualified; no Pass; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 64 error 5105; PDF Reference 1.7 Tables 8.56/8.57 pp. 662-663 for URI actions and explicit Base
rules.title: Bookmark is external to the application
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current-PDF absolute HTTP/HTTPS/mailto URI bookmarks and simple relative URI paths under an explicit qualified HTTP/HTTPS Catalog Base.
rules.implementationNote: Requires complete bounded outline identity, unambiguous URI action, exact capture and successful parsing. Adds simple ASCII relative paths under an explicit well-formed HTTP/HTTPS Catalog URI/Base without userinfo, percent escapes, query or fragment; missing/wrong/unresolved Base and ambiguous relative forms stay unknown. Absolute web/email classification is independent of Base. Parsing is local only, no target requests; evidence retains Web/Email category, not original or combined addresses. Other relative forms, schemes/actions, cross-application files, historical sources and complete ICH Q&A 64 qualification remain incomplete; no Pass; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 65 error 5110; PDF Reference 1.7 Table 8.4 pp. 585-586 for outline action, child and Count semantics
rules.title: Inactive bookmark
rules.applicableScope: Independently qualified current-PDF leaf bookmarks with explicitly absent action, destination, structure-target and child-outline entries.
rules.implementationNote: Requires complete bounded outline identity, exact capture and successful parsing. A/Dest/AA/SE/First/Last must be absent; Count may be absent or a direct integer zero, since zero child-count metadata is not an action. Nonzero/null/indirect/malformed counts remain unknown, and zero cannot bypass any action/child key or bad tree identity. Explicit null actions, failed resolution and parent headings remain unqualified. Other inactive semantics, historical sources and non-PDF-named content remain incomplete; no Pass; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 65 error 5115
rules.title: Non-relative bookmark
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current-PDF GoToR bookmarks using literal slash-rooted absolute file specifications.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent bookmark/file identity, exact capture and consistent successful parsing. Checks raw slash-rooted file specifications without URI decoding, trimming, OS path resolution or target access. Findings retain classification rather than the original path. URI actions, platform/drive variants, other encodings/actions, historical sources and complete referenced-guidance qualification remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 66 error 5117; FDA PDF specification 4.1 printed p. 6 bookmarks magnification; PDF Reference 1.7 Table 8.2 p. 582
rules.title: Bookmark does not inherit zoom
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current GoToR bookmarks explicitly selecting Fit or positive fixed XYZ zoom under archived FDA PDF specification 4.1 from 2016-09-21.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent bounded outline/action identity, complete Fit/positive XYZ syntax, exact capture and successful parsing. Adds simple Filespec dictionaries with nonempty ASCII F and matching optional UF, excluding platform/URL/embedded/related-file and other unqualified keys. Zero/null XYZ retains zoom; conflicting/unknown file identities and malformed destinations cannot authorize a finding. Internal/named targets, other modes/actions/encodings, historical sources and earlier policy remain incomplete; no Pass; still Partial.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 66 error 5200
rules.title: Broken hyperlink pointing to a missing file
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current page-Link GoToR file targets absent from an explicitly selected current or historical sequence inventory.
rules.implementationNote: Requires complete qualified page tree, unique indirect annotation ownership, nondegenerate finite rectangle, consistent page owner, unambiguous GoToR action and simple literal file specification. Fit and valid five-item XYZ destinations qualify file identity; XYZ requires a nonnegative integer page, finite numeric or null coordinates and null or finite nonnegative zoom. Exact source capture and complete selected target inventory are required. Unselected history, existing unreadable files, URI/bookmark/open actions and unsupported annotation/specification variants remain unknown. Historical sources and non-PDF-named contents remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 67 error 5201
rules.title: Corrupt hyperlink pointing to an unopenable file
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current page-Link GoToR targets with existing explicitly selected PDFs having definite content-format opening failures.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent hyperlink identity, complete source-page qualification, literal path resolution and exact source/target capture binding. Incremental association supports either observation order and retains known failure under later limits. Missing files, unselected history, generic parse errors, encryption, I/O and limits cannot prove corruption. Other actions/formats, annotation variants, historical source PDFs and complete parser qualification remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 67 error 5202
rules.title: Hyperlink referencing a non-existent named destination or page
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current page-Link GoToR Fit/XYZ page indexes and complete captured target PDF page trees.
rules.implementationNote: Independent hyperlink identity, raw nonnegative zero-based Fit/XYZ page index, complete page-tree qualification and exact source/target capture binding are required. XYZ requires five items, finite numeric or null coordinates and null or finite nonnegative zoom. Either observation order and shared limits retain known failure. Missing/unreadable files, legacy page counts and unselected history cannot establish absent pages. Named destinations, internal links, other modes/actions, annotation variants and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 68 error 5203
rules.title: Hyperlink triggering multiple actions
rules.applicableScope: Complete qualified current page-Link GoToR action chains.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent page-Link identity, unique annotation ownership, complete source pages, capture binding and a complete bounded supported action chain. Fit and valid five-item XYZ destinations are supported throughout the chain; XYZ requires a nonnegative integer page, finite numeric or null coordinates and null or finite nonnegative zoom. Separate annotations, bookmarks and opening actions are not combined. Unknown/cyclic/malformed/conflicting chains, other actions or file/destination types, annotation variants and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 68 error 5205
rules.title: External hyperlink
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current page-Link absolute HTTP/HTTPS/mailto URI actions and simple relative paths with explicit qualified HTTP/HTTPS Catalog Base.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent page-Link identity, complete page/annotation inventory, unique ownership and exact capture binding. Simple ASCII relative URI paths require explicit HTTP/HTTPS Catalog Base without userinfo, percent escapes, query or fragment; no document-location base is inferred. URI classification is local and only Web/Email category is retained in new regulatory evidence. Other relative/Base forms, schemes/actions, cross-application files, annotation variants and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 68 error 5210
rules.title: Inactive hyperlink
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current page-Link annotations with explicitly absent action/destination/additional-action keys and absent or direct nonnegative integer StructParent.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent Link identity, complete page/annotation inventory, unique ownership and capture binding. Direct nonnegative integer StructParent is structure metadata, not activation; structure-tree validity is not established. Original action/destination/additional-action key absence is not explicit null, failed resolution or unsupported action. Other structure-index forms, annotation variants, other inactive semantics and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 69 error 5215
rules.title: Non-relative hyperlink
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current page-Link GoToR actions with slash-rooted absolute file specifications.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent page-Link identity, complete source-page qualification and capture binding. File specifications are literal, never URI-decoded, trimmed or interpreted with local OS path rules; new findings retain classification only. URI/platform/drive variants, other file/action encodings, annotation variants, historical source PDFs and complete referenced-guidance qualification remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA criteria 4.7 p. 69 error 5217; FDA PDF specification 4.1 p. 6
rules.title: Hyperlink does not inherit zoom
rules.applicableScope: Qualified current page-Link GoToR Fit and positive fixed XYZ zoom settings under archived PDF 4.1.
rules.implementationNote: Requires independent Link identity, complete page/annotation inventory, unique ownership, capture binding and both archived regulatory sources. Fixed policy qualification begins 2016-09-21; earlier applicable dates remain unknown. XYZ zero/null retains zoom and is not a violation. Internal/named destinations, other modes/actions/file encodings, annotation variants and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 23, error 1500; ICH eCTD 3.2.2 physical p. 108 leaf title/keywords definitions
rules.title: Text data was truncated
rules.applicableScope: Unambiguous printable-ASCII overlength direct simple leaf titles and explicit whole keywords values in current ICH/US backbones.
rules.implementationNote: Reports retained printable ASCII values above 512 characters without trimming, token splitting, byte-length inference or rewriting content. Uses unique current XML/rules/assets/limits binding, rooted bounded ancestry and cumulative node/character/finding budgets. Defaults, unavailable raw values, Unicode counting and other title/text scopes remain unqualified. Retained overlength evidence can fail after a later read error; no Pass is emitted.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 4, error 4
rules.title: Submission containing no files
rules.applicableScope: Complete stable inventory of the explicitly selected submission input.
rules.implementationNote: Empty directory and valid ZIP containers fail only after complete safe scanning and stability verification. Directory entries do not count as files; zero-byte files do. Invalid, changed or interrupted inputs do not establish absence.
